compile_policy.benchmark: complete training epoch plus development evaluation after compile/warm-up exclusion
compile_policy.compiled_retention: same-weight forward/loss/unscaled-gradient semantic PASS, full train-epoch + development-evaluation composite delta <= 0.001, workflow throughput speedup >= 1.02; otherwise eager

hardware_policy: CUDA GPU required for B.1 production training; TE1 is not globally CPU-only.
promotion_contract: B.1 selects only provisional offline challengers. Production promotion requires downstream .te1nn/Rust parity and D.3 paired-match/SPRT evidence.

runtime_hardening.bounded_locator: project-root recursive discovery accepts renamed copies only after exact byte-size, SHA-256, VERSION, CRC, and complete manifest verification
runtime_hardening.hardware_sealed_resume: GPU name and compute capability are part of compile-selection and training checkpoint signatures; hardware-class changes fail closed rather than silently mixing campaigns
runtime_hardening.manifest_schema_compatibility: notebook verifier accepts strict TE1 outer manifest records or files schemas

unsafe_rust_policy: unchanged: justified isolated unsafe Rust remains allowed in later D.2 runtime hot paths with scalar oracle and differential tests.
